usageNotes: Returns the certificate sub-resource index for a node, listing available child endpoints (acme, info, custom). Use this as a discovery call to confirm which certificate management paths are available on a target node before drilling into certificate details or ACME operations. No privileges beyond a valid user session are required, but the node must be reachable.

examples.summary: List certificate sub-resources on node pve1

tips: This is an index endpoint — it returns navigational links, not actual certificate data. Use get_nodes_node_certificates_info to retrieve the active TLS certificate details.
Available for all authenticated users; no Sys.Audit or similar privilege is required.
The response 'name' field in each item maps to the child path segment (e.g. 'acme', 'info', 'custom').
